5493c20e7f.q: What is a darkness retreat and how does it work in practice?
5493c20e7f.a: A darkness retreat involves staying in a room with blackout material covering all doors and windows, plus an additional layer covering the entire wall to prevent any light from entering. Matthew Adams spent 17 days in such a retreat in Mexico in 2022, and returned for another 14-day retreat three years later. Ancient indigenous cultures have used darkness retreats to develop shamanic abilities in children and to facilitate healing.

b9085101c3.q: How did ancient indigenous cultures use darkness retreats for spiritual development?
b9085101c3.a: Indigenous cultures used darkness retreats to identify children showing signs of becoming shamans, keeping them in darkness for most of their childhood to develop their shamanic abilities. Darkness retreats were also used in communities to facilitate healing when individuals needed it. Modern hospitals now integrate shamans working alongside Western medicine, blending these ancient practices with contemporary healthcare.

The podcast explores how curiosity creates genuine human connection and aims to bring back lessons and knowledge from transformative spiritual experiences that most people cannot access firsthand.
